text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon. On the way back from buying 
supplies with Shinko Windy...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you know? That Chinese place by 
the station that's famous for its 
mega-portion fried rice?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I saw that online, it's way too 
insane. If you could finish that 
giga-portion, you'd be a legend. A total 
legend.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Nisshisshi! I just overheard something 
great!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you finish all of that fried rice, 
everyone's gonna be super amazed!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That settles what we're doing for lunch! 
Windy-chan is gonna become a legend!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Shinko Windy ordered the 
challenge menu for Umamusume—the 
Giga-Sized Fried Rice, but..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...Gaaah! It's not going down at 
all~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Not being particularly known as a big 
eater, Shinko Windy seemed to reach her 
limit in no time."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guuuugh... I-I can't give up here...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become a legend...! I will 
definitely eat it all to the very last 
bite――!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Mind your own business! Windy-chan can 
still keep eating...!"
choice_data_list:
Just taking on the challenge is an 
achievement in itself.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: M-Mmh...!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...I-If you're going that far, I might 
just let you take me home!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The Legend of Windy-chan will continue 
next time! Look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she said that, Shinko Windy had a 
somewhat relieved look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course I do!! Something like this is 
a piece of cake!! Raaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as Shinko Windy started eating again, 
the customers who noticed her suddenly 
began to make a stir.

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, that girl's taking on the Giga 
Portion! I don't believe it! What a 
challenger!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
!! Wahahaha! Behold, as I show you a true 
legend!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
How's that, I cleaned my plate...! 
Wahaha...! I-It was a piece of cake...!

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO! You're incredible! I got to 
witness a living legend!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to being in the center of 
everyone's attention, Shinko Windy managed 
to push past her limits, and though she 
looked in pain, she left the shop with a 
satisfied face.
